decision: Decision of 2026-10-20: each requirement that needs a physical board is closed by a software and simulation review. This file lists the scenarios; a separate reviewer judges each one by software analysis or simulation only. A scenario judged 'should not pass' is a defect.

scenarios.title: packages/zplc-hil compiles a test program with the repository compiler
scenarios.title_es: packages/zplc-hil compila un programa de prueba con el compilador del repositorio
scenarios.given: a HILTestCase with ST source and no precompiled bytes
scenarios.then: the bytecode comes from the repository compiler (not a table of bytes) and a compile error is raised as an error, never swallowed

simulation_evidence.ref: packages/zplc-hil/tests/runner.test.ts: the runner compiles, deploys, starts and observes (HIL-001)
